events.title: Silberheim Evolving Card Game Roadmap
events.summary: With less than two weeks to go until Silberheim ECG’s big Steam release, it’s time to share our roadmap with you. Of course, release day won’t mark the end of development – it will kick off the next chapter. True to the name of our Evolving Card Game, your cards will continue to evolve, and so will the entire world and the game itself.We’ve spent a long time working on these plans, taking your feedback into account and turning it into carefully considered next steps. And because we remain committed to the value of handcrafted artwork, we intend to replace all AI placeholders for the release version – a project we previously discussed in greater detail in an article on the Silberheim website. events.summary: This year’s Summer Game Fest took place from June 5–8. For the first time, the German Indie Showcase was also part of the event—including Silberheim Evolving Card Game! events.title: The Silberheim ECG Beta launches on 27 March
events.summary: Dear soul,it’s time to prove yourself in Silberheim!As part of a two-week beta test, we’re putting our evolving card game Silberheim through its paces. Take this chance to get a sneak peek at the game before its release and give us your unfiltered thoughts. Taking part is completely free – because we benefit most from any bugs you find and the feedback you provide.It all kicks off on Friday, 27 March at 3:51 pm.
